answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents join an interconnected trust trellis where every identity requires irreversible cryptographic stake burning. An agent deposits rare jade tokens into a burn contract; the cost to register $k$ identities scales superlinearly as $C(k) = O(k^{2.5})$, imposing exponential economic friction. If any node emits an unverifiable whisper of malicious consensus, slashed collateral cascades through adjacent links, making coordinate flood attacks mathematically unaffordable.
